about.heading: Fountainhead Preschool Adajan
about.intro: Fountainhead Preschool Adajan (FPA) brings the renowned Fountainhead early years experience to the heart of Adajan, Surat. With the same IB PYP-aligned philosophy that underpins FSK and all FS Group campuses, FPA is the ideal starting point for a child's lifelong love of learning. At FPA, every child's curiosity is celebrated. Our warm, nurturing environment is designed to help young learners discover who they are, how they express themselves, and how the world works — through inquiry, play, and collaboration.

learningPillars.title: Learner Agency
learningPillars.body: Children are active agents of their own learning — with genuine choice, voice, and ownership from the very first day at FPA.

learningPillars.title: Inquiry Through Play
learningPillars.body: Play is the most powerful form of learning in early childhood. Every activity at FPA provokes curiosity and exploration.

learningPillars.title: Social-Emotional Resilience
learningPillars.body: We develop emotional vocabulary and the resilience children need to navigate relationships and the world around them.

learningPillars.title: Environment as Third Teacher
learningPillars.body: FPA classrooms are designed intentionally — spaces that invite exploration, ground children, and extend their thinking.

academics.heading: Learning at FPA

programmes.title: Nursery

programmes.title: Mixed Age Kindergarten
programmes.body: Mon–Fri, 5h. IB PYP-aligned full programme for pre-primary children. Staff ratio: 1:10.

academics.learningModelText1: IB Primary Years Programme-aligned early childhood education. Four pillars: Learner Agency, Inquiry-Based Play, Social-Emotional Resilience, and the Environment as Third Teacher.
academics.learningModelText2: Mornings begin with an inquiry provocation — a question, an object, a problem to explore. Children move through planned and child-led activities, spending time outdoors, in the arts corner, in the library, and in conversation with each other and their teachers. No two days look exactly alike — and that's the point.
